newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume eases as prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume eases as prices rise.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange dropped to 1,123 kilos on Friday from 1,335 kilos on Thursday as price rose ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Gold closed at $345.00 an ounce and 1,589,200 lira per gram, up from yesterday's $341.00 and 1,562,000 lira in line with firmer levels on European markets.
The lira weakened to 142,960 against the dollar from Thursday's 142,490 close due to the U.S. currency's gains against the mark in world markets.
This also supported higher gold prices on the Exchange.
Most of the the day's trade -- 688 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 54.6 percent of trade conducted in lira terms.
